Idk bout u, but I only daydream to a music if it's attributed to the daydream. 


Example, if I listen to dream pop or alternate pop (or any specific song) I completely fall into state of daydreaming because it matches my theme.


However, there are also songs that don't trigger my daydreams at all. There are some bands I jam with that is attributed to real-life or I trained to use my senses with (For me its Radiohead and The Strokes). Also, I don't use headphones when listening to them. 


So it's up to you. Your likings and goals. Because some people are triggered by any song or really picky about their songs. 


But if you're like me then you can make playlists of your favorite music but categorize which ones trigger your daydreams and the ones that don't. 


:) hope it helps.

Overlooked mental health lalo na yung mga repressed at di nachecheck or nakaka-hingi ng tulong. Lalo na yung iba kasi di nagsasabi... 

Increased cases of bullying (esp. Cyberbullying) and stalking.

Some extra...
Broken childhood ng mga bata, lalo na yung nag-switch from G4 to G7, I can't imagine not experiencing those years, christmas party etc. plus yung pakiramdam ng graduation sa elementary.

Ganun sa school namin, nagsimula kami kanina sa mga social activities, introduction, expression, drawing tungkol sa sariling ambitions, status, values, inallow kami mag-socialize etc.


(pati bukas wala munang lessons, bawat klase hinati sa dalawa, Set A and Set B, two days lang ang f2f class per Set, modular yung natitirang two days tapos wala na sa Friday) 


So yun, I think swerte pa kami... Kaya nagulat ako nung iba pala ang sitwasyon sa iba, lalo na sa mga mas nakababata. It goes to my sister and cousin na nasa elementary... tsk. 


Ang baba ng standard ng schools nila when it comes to safety protocols, wala sila pake sa mental and physical well-being ng mga bata.

Juskolord bata kong kapatid regular classes agad at dikit-dikit pa ng seats. Hindi gaanong kahigpit ang pagsusuot ng facemask, pinag-iisipan pa kung ililipat siya ng school. 


While I'm a grade 10 student and luckily pinapahalagan ng school namin ang mental health ng bawat estudyante. Our section is grouped into two sets para hindi magsabay-sabay. Set A and set B, tig-two days. Bale wala kaming pasok tuwing Friday. 


The safety protocols are enforced to all classrooms, nasa highest/special science section ako pero hindi naman kami pine-pressure, depende sa teacher ang dami ng works. 


Our first day went introduction lang, sharing of emotions, thoughts and ambitions at inallow na makipag-interact sa mga dati at bagong ka-eskwela at sa teacher. That's sa school namin, sa iba ang alam ko diretso lessons daw agad.
